verdict: The AI render demonstrates high fidelity to the original design intent, capturing the core geometric language and accent placement accurately.
intent: To translate a stylized, high-contrast sketch into a realistic, production-ready 3D visualization while maintaining specific graphic motifs.

evidence.sourceEvidence: Continuous orange-red horizontal light bar spanning the rear width with specific notched ends.
evidence.resultEvidence: Thin, continuous red LED strip following the exact horizontal profile and width.
evidence.reason: The lighting signature is a primary brand identity element.

evidence.sourceEvidence: Orange diagonal slash on the C-pillar and orange trim on the lower side sill and rear diffuser.
evidence.resultEvidence: Identical orange geometric accents located in the same spatial positions on the bodywork.
evidence.reason: Graphic placement defines the vehicle's visual energy and color scheme.

evidence.sourceEvidence: Sketch shows highly stylized, almost abstract geometric spoke patterns with thick orange highlights.
evidence.resultEvidence: More realistic, structured five-spoke design that simplifies the sketch's aggressive geometry.
evidence.reason: Wheel design often drifts toward realism in AI renders, losing extreme sketch stylization.

evidence.sourceEvidence: High beltline, sloping roofline, and chunky, squared-off wheel arches.
evidence.resultEvidence: Maintains the compact SUV/Crossover proportions and the specific 'floating roof' aesthetic.
evidence.reason: Silhouette defines the vehicle's segment and stance.

brief: The render is highly successful; to improve, increase the geometric complexity and abstraction of the wheel spoke patterns to match the sketch's avant-garde style.
promptPatch: hyper-realistic automotive render, high-contrast white and black bodywork, aggressive geometric orange accent graphics on C-pillar and side sills, continuous thin LED rear light bar, avant-garde abstract geometric wheels with orange highlights, studio lighting, 8k resolution, maintaining exact proportions of the source sketch.
